newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: TABLE - Gensec yr shr doubles, div hiked.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Gensec yr shr doubles, div hiked.

text.p: Full Name: Genbel Securities Ltd (banks and financial services)

NOTE - Directors said Gensec, a securities and investment trading firm whose profitability is largely linked to South African equity market movements, would post positive real earnings growth in the 1997/98 year in the event of reasonable increases in shares on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange.

Gensec, which was listed in May 1996, would award capitalisation shares to those registered on August 15. The award will be in the ratio that 65 cents multiplied by 1.07 bears to the weighted average traded share price on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange for the four days ending October 6.
Shareholders can instead elect to receive the dividend.
